posts.title: The AI Tools I'd Use for Early-Stage Startup Validation
posts.description: I asked ChatGPT which AI tools to use for startup validation. The list was good, but every tool on it does one job. Here's how I'd use them, stage by stage, and the job none of them does.

posts.title: The Just Start Manifesto: AI Edition
posts.description: AI made building free. That is worse than it sounds. Why you still don’t need permission to start, rewritten for the age of AI and the Founder Economy.

posts.title: AI Changed How I Interview Customers, but Not Why
posts.description: I've promised this post three times. Over 15 years, my interviewing rules sorted themselves into evergreen strategies and tactics that keep changing, and AI is the biggest change to the tactics yet. Fourth post in Running Lean: AI Edition.
